newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says to issue statement on Nissan Life.
newsitem.headline: MOF says to issue statement on Nissan Life.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a parliamentary committee on Friday he would issue a statement on Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co in the afternoon.
He said the ministry had ordered Nissan Life to halt some of its operations at 9 a.m. (0000 GMT) on Friday after the firm decided it could no longer continue business.
The firm is currently in the process of preparing for an outside entity to supervise its assets, Mitsuzuka said.
He also said the ministry would take every possible measure under a new insurance law to protect policyholders.
MOF said in a statement earlier that it had ordered Nissan Mutual Life to halt some of its operations, such as making or cancelling contracts.
